programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The night before the Asian Tournament, Kevin decides to steal data from Kenny's laptop to get the edge for his White Tiger Team. Unfortunately, Kenny catches him red-handed which sets up a battle between Ray and Kevin, which ends in dire consequences for Ray.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After realizing his Bit Beast is gone, Ray decides to head for the mountains in an attempt to get it back. Tyson and Mariah give chase and confront Ray to decide which team he wants to be on.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The White Tiger Team faces off against the Spin-Shepards in the quarterfinals of the Asian Tournament. When Ray sees that Lee is also using the 'Tiger Claw' attack, he is forced to finally open up to his teammates about his mysterious past.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It's the morning of the semi-finals at the Asian Beyblade Tournament and Tyson manages to sleep in. The rest of the team leaves early, but Ray stays behind to make sure Tyson wakes up. As the tournament gets underway, Max is the first to battle. Meanwhile, Ray and Tyson are caught up in a traffic jam created by a landslide, so they decide to walk. But the shortest route is over a mountain where Ray sprains his ankle and Tyson is left to carrying him all the way to there.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The finals are about to begin in the Asian Qualifying Tournament with the winning team advancing to the World Beyblading Championships. In the first round, Max goes against Gary from the White Tigers in a best of three battle. The first round goes without a hitch as Max easily takes care of his opponent and with the win, Max becomes a little over confident.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: During the finals of the Asian Tournament, Ray faces off against his old teammate, and former friend, Mariah. When Galux and Driger team up to show the pair a glimpse of the happiness they shared in the past, Ray and Mariah come to realize how much they have lost, by being rivals.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The final match of the Asian Beyblade Tournament reaches an uncertain conclusion when Tyson and Lee's decisive battle ends in a draw. The resulting sudden death session between Ray and Lee rekindles the pair's old hometown grievances.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Fresh from the Bladebreakers win in Asia, Tyson comes home and realizes he's front page news! With his ego out of control, Tyson takes on the attitude of a rock star, which upsets Kenny who tries to keep him focused on blading and not his popularity. Meanwhile, at a local playground, the local kids are all out Beyblading when Tyson spots a kid (Nicky), being smoked in the Beystadium by a bully (Riley). After Nicky's blade is completely destroyed, Tyson vows to help the kid fix it and fight his way back.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in the USA for the American Tournament. During a tour of a BBA research facility, Max is shocked to learn that his Mom works there, and not at the college, like he thought. To make matters worse, the team discovers that they are being tested for weaknesses, by a competing team.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After their non-competition loss to Emily of the All Starz at the BBA Research Center, the Blade Breakers sneak around the high-tech facility, hoping to learn more about their competition. There, they confront two other All Starz, and Max learns more about his Mom's job at the BBA - specifically, a rumor of why Max wasn't asked to join the All Starz Team.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: For some strange reason, Mr. Dickenson has sent the Blade Breakers to a remote mountain retreat to hone their blading skills for the upcoming American Tournament as well as to get Kenny and Dizzi to figure out a way to increase Ray's Bit Beast's power. Once there, they meet up with a enthusiastic young boy named Antonio who they think is there to train them. Turns out, Antonio is a pathetic blader.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: A charity event in the Heartland of America gives the Bladebreakers a taste of the All Starz' prowess. Featuring celebrities in a three-on-three contest against young Beybladers of note, Emily of the All Starz, bullies her way to an easy win. It isn't until Emily knocks out her own opponent, loses the second match and is on her way to throwing the whole competition, that Max teaches her what teamwork is all about.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Las Vegas for the start of the American Tournament. Tyson looks forward to facing off against the arrogant All-Starz, and their scientifically advanced Beyblades'but first his team needs to get past the 'Renegades' in the qualifying round. Kai surprises everyone by stepping into the dish for the first battle!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Blade Breakers have advanced to the second round of the American Tournament where they square off against the Savage Slammers. The winner of this round advances to the semi-finals. Their competition first appears to be a bunch of slackers, but when Ray loses out in the first round, they quickly realize what they're up against. Max is next, and for some odd reason, his rival folds under pressure, so the best of three is tied at one a piece with Tyson coming in for the deciding battle.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It's the Bladebreakers versus Spintensity in the semi-finals of the American Tournament. But before the match can begin, Tyson is forced to withdraw with a stomachache he got from too much celebratory eating. Max, Ray and Kai must drag race their crafty foes through the whirlwind, highway-themed dish called the New Jersey Turnpike.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tensions rise as the American Tournament heats up. Max fights for a chance to beyblade against his mother's team the All-Starz in an upcoming match, while Tyson and the rest of the Bladebreakers realize that the All-Starz are a bigger threat then they previously thought. At the end of two tense rounds, Tyson and Steven are tied one-all'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It's the finals of the American Tournament and the Bladebreakers are going head to head with the All Starz with the winner going to the World Championships. In the first round, Tyson is pitted against Steve and at first things don't appear to be going Tyson's way. But with sheer determination, Tyson pulls out a victory that puts the Bladebreakers ahead one to nothing in the best of three finals.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The deciding match of the American Tournament Finals comes down to Max vs. Michael of the 'All Starz,' in a battle that pits science and technology against human spirit. Unfortunately for Max and the Bladebreakers, the trick dish turns out to be a replica of a baseball diamond'where Michael feels right at home!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After narrowly defeating the All Starz at the American Tournament, Kenny decides he should record a database of the highs and low points of the BladeBreakers since the very beginning. In fact, through a series of flashbacks, the Chief along with Dizzi, takes a trip down memory lane as far back to the first time he ever met Tyson. With clips from various shows, Kenny narrates the progress of his friends who eventually form the BladeBreakers and go on to the Asian Tournament.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Traveling by boat across the Atlantic, the Bladebreakers must not only deal with Kenny's seasickness, but a gut-wrenching revelation. Tyson's on-board defeat at the hands of a mysterious foe - one wielding a Bit-Beast larger and stronger than any they've ever seen - exposes the team's vulnerability going into the Russian Tournament.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The kids are tricked into missing their boat, forcing them to spend the night in London where a mysterious videotape of Tyson's father is delivered to them. Later, Tyson's Beyblade is stolen and the kids are lured into a fight with the evil Cenotaph and his powerful Bit Beast, Sarcopholon. All seems lost until Kai defeats the mummy by using his own strengths against him. The team agrees to travel by land, learning from every European Beyblader they can find.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.sub-title: Darkness At The End Of The Tunnel
programme.desc: After their train is mysteriously hijacked, the kids find themselves in the dark recesses of a tunnel. This is where the Bladebreakers meet the members of the Dark Bladers! Soon the team is forced into a beyblade match to rescue Kenny from the monsters' evil clutches! But Kenny isn't the only prize in this dark match-up. For if the Bladebreakers lose, their bit-beasts are up for grabs'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: As the BladeBreakers make their way to the World Championships in Russia, they are stuck in Paris where they end up wasting a day looking for Kai who had mysteriously disappeared. Tyson comes up with the idea of using the Eiffel Tower as a vantage point to speed up their search. Ray, Kenny, Tyson and Max make their way to the observation deck of the tower where they are confronted by the Dark Bladers, a foursome of zombie-like ghouls who have vowed to steal the Bladebreakers Bit Beasts as part of their ultimate plan to capture all Bit Beasts in the world. A massive battle ensues but the odds are against our heroes. Finally, Kai shows up with his newly modified Dranzer and almost single-handedly wins the battle. The Dark Bladers fade away after their humiliating loss and just when you'd think it's over, a mysterious kid named Oliver shows up'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers spend an extra day in Paris and split up to see the sights. Ray catches up with his uncle, Max goes on a wild shopping spree and Kai goes in search of information. Tyson and Kenny try to see the Louvre but end up Beyblading Oliver, the French Champion. At first Oliver's Bit Beast, Unicolyon, is too much for Dragoon. But Tyson soon proves that even the French Champion has a thing or two to learn about Beyblading.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Rome, searching for the mysterious Enrique. Scoffing at their Beyblade challenge, Enrique decides he'd rather spend the day with some of his lady-friends. But Tyson soon convinces him to 'Let it rip!' And after seeing Enrique's personalized BeyStadium, and his outrageous bit-beast, there's a good chance that Tyson may regret his actions'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Unwilling to let his initial defeat to Enrique faze him, Tyson gets busy reworking his Beyblade. With Enrique having doubts about his own technique, and Oliver visiting him in Rome from France, the stage is set for a rematch. This time, Tyson pits the two heads of Enrique's Bit Beast Amphilyon against each other, and saves Enrique's life when Amphilyon turns on him.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Enrique and Oliver decide to take our heroes on a dirigible ride to visit Robert's castle. The reason - Tyson hopes to avenge an earlier loss to Robert that happened onboard the ship coming to Europe. Tyson's patience, however, is tested when they have to sit and wait for their host who is 'not to be disturbed.' So, Tyson decides to find Robert on his own and ends up getting lost in the medieval castles many eerie secret passages. Finally everyone converges in the room where Robert is playing chess against Johnny and it's here where Tyson throws down the gauntlet and challenges Robert to a rematch. Robert refuses and goes into a whole history lesson about how 'once you've defeated your enemy, the battle is over.' Meanwhile, the arrogant little Johnny decides to pick a battle with the most-worthy opponent in the room and chooses Kai. As the fight begins, it appears to be even, but then Johnny calls out his Bit Beast Salamulyon and totally destroys him. In the end, the Bladebreakers resolve that they have their work cut out for them to become the world champion Beybladers!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers have made themselves at home at Robert's mansion, refusing to leave unless the Europeans agree to a final Beybattle. To teach his guests a lesson, Robert agrees to a match at his new stadium. But there's one condition: If the Bladebreakers lose, they have to forfeit their berth at the world Championship. Ray and Oliver battle fiercely and the first round ends in a tie. Johnny and Kai, bitter rivals, step to the bowl. But can Kai defeat the man who defeated him?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Match two gets underway at the Olympia Coliseum, and with a little unsolicited help by his teammates, Kai walks away with a win. The match is tied and the Majestics grudgingly admit to themselves that the only way they'll win the contest is to fight as a team, as the Bladebreakers do. Facing off against Tyson in the final match, will Robert be able to apply the fundamentals of teamwork? And will the Bladebreakers ever discover who sent them on their cross-Europe trip in the first place'?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.sub-title: Hot Battle In A Cold Town
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Moscow on a brisk winter's day in anticipation of the World Beyblading final tournament. As they search for their hotel in the chilly city, they happen upon Boris, a strange man who claims to be the head of a rather eerie Beyblading training center. With the charm of an old world count, Boris invites them to lunch and them brings them to the training facility where they meet the next generation of Beybladers. It's here where Boris decides that one of his pupils should test his blading skills against Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers run into some old friends in Russia when The All-Starz and the White Tiger Clan show up for an exhibition match. The Beybattle between the two teams ends in a tie and they become fast friends, except for Emily and Mariah, who refuse to speak to each other. Meanwhile, Kai returns to the Abbey to find out why it fills him with foreboding. He discovers a cruel Beyblade facility in the Sub-basements, housing twisted science experiments and an army of children being molded into deadly Beybladers. Kai's lost memories come flooding back as he realizes he was raised in the abbey. But has he discovered the truth too late?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Kai is torn between escaping the Abbey, and exploring it further in an attempt to unlock forgotten memories from his childhood. The Bladebreakers track down their missing teammate to the Abbey, but are denied access by two of its wunderkind bladers. When Kai discovers the existence of Black Dranzer, the world's most powerful Beyblade, Boris offers it to him - but only if Kai quits the Bladebreakers forever and rejoins the Biovolt Corporation. Flooded with memories of using Black Dranzer as a child, and the lure of its dark, corrupting power leads Kai to a shocking decision.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It's the first day of the Beyblade World Championships in Moscow, and as our heroes leave their hotel, they still haven't been able to locate Kai who's been missing for some time. Regardless, they arrive at the tournament and meet up with both the White Tigers and the All Starz who invite them to watch their first match against the Demolition Boys. At first things seem fairly normal, that is, until they start to battle. Things go from bad to worse for the All Starz who are no match for the Demolition Boys who quickly go up 2-0 in the best of five events. In the next match, Michael has to square off against a mystery member of the Demolition Boys and it turns out to be none other than Kai who has defected from the Bladebreakers. In the final battle, Kai takes on all the All Starz at once' and wins!! After his victory, he commands the All Starz Bit Beasts to enter his blade and he announces to the world that he now possesses the most powerful Beyblade in the world!!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Determined to avenge the All-Starz' devastating defeat, the White Tigers face Kai in the Tournament. One by one, they fall before the power of Black Dranzer and watch, horrified, as their Bit Beasts are absorbed into Kai's Beyblade. The Bladebreakers storm the abbey in a desperate attempt to free their teammate. Tyson stumbles into Biovolt's secret lab and learns the truth about Kai's past from a gloating Boris. Tyson refuses to give up on his friend until Kai hands over his old Beyblade and tells him to leave. Will the Bladebreakers survive the loss of their most powerful member?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Downtrodden and dejected, the Bladebreakers ask themselves over and over again: 'Why would Kai betray us?' Soon enough, however, the boys get a chance to ask him themselves. Summoned by Kai to Beyblade on a frozen lake, the Bladebreakers must not only win to save their Bit Beasts, but must convince Kai that they will always be his teammates. Can they do it'?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Now that Kai is finally loyal to the 'Bladebreakers,' he returns the Black Dranzer to Boris, doing severe damage to the enemy headquarters in the process. Voltaire orders the operation to proceed, and Boris brings in the Demolition Boys to get the job done. It is revealed that BioVolt is creating a breed of powerful, savage, Bit-Beasts that are designed for War'and the plan is to use them to take over the entire World. The Demolition Boys attack the BBA bus, and Max bravely battles to save his friends. Unfortunately he loses his Bit-Beast, Draciel, in the process'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers are stranded on the barren Russian Tundra after their run-in with the Demolition Boys when the Majestics mysteriously show up in their bus. After picking our heroes up, they stop at an abandoned palace where Robert challenges Tyson to battle. At first it seems strange that Robert would do this, but Tyson accepts and a battle ensues with Tyson losing two straight. He becomes infuriated! Robert then tells Tyson that he must harness his power back into his blade, which totally confuses Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The World Championship Finals are finally here and Kai insists on Beybattling first, hoping his knowledge of the Demolition Boys will give him an advantage over Spencer. But in the first set, Seaborg, Spencer's whale Bit Beast, uses the water in the Black Sea Bowl to create a tsunami, which overwhelms Dranzer. Kai is desperate for victory and Voltaire makes him a tempting offer: the power of Black Dranzer in exchange for betraying his friends and stealing their Bit Beasts. Kai stays true to his heart and resists his grandfather.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After Kai's first round loss to the Demolition Boys in the World Beyblade Finals, it's Ray's turn to take on Bryan in a best-of-three match. Ray learns the hard way that Bryan is a nasty competitor who'll do anything to win - including putting Ray himself through the ringer. When it's discovered that Bryan's attack includes the ability to manipulate air itself into a weapon, Ray faces a troubling realization. To negate Bryan's fury, he must put his own well being at risk. But Ray's Bit-Beast Driger has other ideas, and it offers up selfless act of its own.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After a devastating match puts Ray in the hospital, Tyson trains his heart out to prepare for his battle against Tala, leader of the Demolition Boys. What Tyson doesn't know is that Tala has become one of Boris' weird experiments, uploaded with dangerous Biovolt technology. Meanwhile, Max's parents work together to come up with an improved Beyblade that can combat the existing threat of the Demolition Boys' prowess. Can it even come close to competing against'Cyber-Tala?

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It is the finals of the World Beyblading Championships in Moscow with Tala from the Demolition Boys and Tyson tied at one game a piece in the best of three finals. With the victory, the tide has turned in favor of Tala who warps the two warriors into a giant iceberg where there is no contact with the outside world. The second battle begins, and it takes little time for Tala to combine his multiple Bit Beasts into one and take the lead in the best of three finals. Meanwhile, the evil Voltaire, head of the Biovolt Corporation looks on and begins celebrating the victory, which translates into his domination of the corporate world.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tyson is at home practicing martial arts with his grandfather when suddenly he realizes he's late for a Beyblade battle with Andrew. As he runs out of his house he's confronted by a couple of bullies who only slow him up for his real battle. But when Tyson does show up, Andrew and his friends are met by a smart mouthed kid named Carlos who's a member of the notorious Blade Sharks. Carlos challenges anyone to a battle but the winner gets to keep the others Beyblades. Tyson accepts. With the help of Kenny and his Bit Beast Dizzi, who's trapped inside his laptop, Tyson prepares for the big battle, which he handily wins. But the just when the fight is over, the Blade Shark's leader Kai shows up and a new battle begins between Kai and Tyson

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tyson battles Kai one on one, but to his surprise, Tyson quickly loses. The Chief informs Tyson, that in order to beat Kai, you need a strategy, so Tyson goes home in an attempt to practice until he's perfected his fighting technique. Later that day, Andrew and Kenny, along with Dizzi show up and attempt to increase the power of Tyson's blade to match that of Kai, but with little success. Tyson is feeling glum about his chances of ever beating Kai, but suddenly, out of nowhere, the Bit Beast Dragoon appears and flies straight towards him and goes directly into Tyson's beyblade. Tyson is stunned after realizing Dragoon does exists and is now inside his beyblade. With renewed confidence, Tyson knows the time is right to challenge Kai once again to do battle.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: In a moment of heroism, Max, the new Beyblader in town, shows Tyson that with the proper skill and training, there is nothing that can't be achieved. The two soon become fast friends, leaving Kenny feeling left out.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Beyblade Regional Qualifying Tournament is underway as Tyson, Max, Ray and even Kenny are entered to see if they can dethrone Kai, the reigning champion. As our announcers, Brad Best and A.J. Topper rev up the crowd, Kenny is first into battle but without a Bit Beast in his blade, he falls quickly to Kai.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Max is completely overpowered in his semi-finals match against Kai. It's not until the Bit Beast known as Draciel emerges from Max's Grandmother's pendant, to add its power to Max's Beyblade that the tables begin to turn.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The Qualifying Tournament is in its final stages as Tyson has advanced to face Ray in the semi-finals. As the best of three battles gets underway, Tyson's bravado quickly fades as Ray handily wins the first round when he destroys Tyson's Beyblade with his famous Tiger Claw Attack.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The National Beyblade Championship Match is set, with Tyson facing off against reigning champion, Kai. It's not until Grandpa throws a surprise party for Tyson, that the rookie sensation realizes he's forgotten his own Birthday!

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Tyson and his team prepare for the Hong Kong world championships. Kai seems to reject his newfound team and leads them on a chase through the streets. That's where the guys learn some lessons about Beyblading from some very mysterious 'bladers. After a decisive victory, Tyson and the gang discover that the alley bladders make up the membership of 'The White Tiger Team'' Whatever that is'

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: Our heroes arrive in Hong Kong on a stop-over to the Asian Beyblade Tournament when they run into Ray's old gang the White Tigers. A confrontation quickly ensues with no one coming out the clear winner.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The first round of the Asian Tournament sees the Bladebreakers facing off against the team called the Tall-Boys, with Ray's ex-teammates, The White Tigers, waiting in the wings.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The night before the Asian Tournament, Kevin decides to steal data from Kenny's laptop to get the edge for his White Tiger Team. Unfortunately, Kenny catches him red-handed which sets up a battle between Ray and Kevin, which ends in dire consequences for Ray.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: After realizing his Bit Beast is gone, Ray decides to head for the mountains in an attempt to get it back. Tyson and Mariah give chase and confront Ray to decide which team he wants to be on.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The White Tiger Team faces off against the Spin-Shepards in the quarterfinals of the Asian Tournament. When Ray sees that Lee is also using the 'Tiger Claw' attack, he is forced to finally open up to his teammates about his mysterious past.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: It's the morning of the semi-finals at the Asian Beyblade Tournament and Tyson manages to sleep in. The rest of the team leaves early, but Ray stays behind to make sure Tyson wakes up. As the tournament gets underway, Max is the first to battle. Meanwhile, Ray and Tyson are caught up in a traffic jam created by a landslide, so they decide to walk. But the shortest route is over a mountain where Ray sprains his ankle and Tyson is left to carrying him all the way to there.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: The finals are about to begin in the Asian Qualifying Tournament with the winning team advancing to the World Beyblading Championships. In the first round, Max goes against Gary from the White Tigers in a best of three battle. The first round goes without a hitch as Max easily takes care of his opponent and with the win, Max becomes a little over confident.

programme.title: Beyblade
programme.desc: During the finals of the Asian Tournament, Ray faces off against his old teammate, and former friend, Mariah. When Galux and Driger team up to show the pair a glimpse of the happiness they shared in the past, Ray and Mariah come to realize how much they have lost, by being rivals.

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP11 Kid, Conan, and the Ryoma Treasure Illusion [English Dub]
programme.desc: The Detective Conan crossover concludes with a night at the museum, in which Kid goes out of his way to return stolen items amid a crowd of adoring fans, the police who want to take him down, and a couple of real criminals!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP12 Two Kid the Phantom Thieves [English Dub]
programme.desc: When the greedy owner of a department store has an employee impersonate Kid the Phantom Thief to steal the Star of the Giants, he doesn't count on the real Kid showing up on Christmas Eve to foil his plan!

programme.title: Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Movie: Mugen Train [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Tanjiro and Nezuko, along with Zenitsu and Inosuke, join one of the most powerful swordsmen within the Demon Slayer Corps, Flame Hashira Kyojuro Rengoku, to face the demon aboard the Mugen Train on track to despair.

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E01 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.desc: Host Naydyeyah Acoy-Thomas traces the rich, layered history of St. Croix’s musical roots, uncovering the deep ties to African, European, and indigenous Taíno traditions. programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

La salud de Mar a Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que tambi n tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relaci n extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. programme.desc: A la ma ana siguiente Egl e recibe con emoci n la llegada de R mulo a su casa no pudiendo dejar de reconocerle su sentimiento de perdida al haber pasado unos d as sin su presencia y sentir incluso que lo extra aba, R mulo sinti ndose extra ado por la actitud de su ex esposa se siente conmovido y a la vez regocijado por las atenciones de Egl e para despu s repreguntarse por el motivo de su actitud y reconocer tambi n ante su ex esposa que se sent a vac o durante los d as que estuvo alejado de su primera familia. Betzaida recibe la visita de sus padres mientras desahoga la molestia de saber a R mulo en casa de Egl e escuchando la m sica de Mozart. ngel se sorprende al recibir la visita de Ed n quien llevado por la duda de su inter s por Pascuita le pide a ngel hacerle una consulta, ngel en su lectura concluye que Ed n esta loco de amor por una de sus eventuales clientas. Pascuita pone en practica uno de los ejercicios recomendados por Ed n para que intente llevar una vida familiar armoniosa y sin tensiones ejercicio que implica mas libertades en sus tareas diarias y para con su familia, Pascuita pone de su parte al refrenar sus compulsiones y permitir que su familia pueda hacer lo que se le antoje durante el d a. A la ma ana siguiente Gonzalo se muestra colaborador y complaciente ante las obligaciones de trabajo de Matilde llegando a proponer una salida con sus hijos y Ernesto para dejar a Matilde terminar con su trabajo, oblig ndose a mantener en silencio sus quejas Gonzalo no sabe por cuanto tiempo aguantara lo que para el implica un sacrificio, y lo que para Matilde significa sus responsabilidades de la vida diaria. A su encuentro con Dileidy Yenil conversa con su amiga sobre su situaci n con Gonzalo asumiendo el echo de su separaci n con Matilde como una realidad, pero por otra parte sintiendo la duda de tener las dos versiones diferentes de la pareja, Yenil se enga a as misma al creer a Gonzalo capaz de dejar a Matilde por estar con ella, Dileidy aconseja a Yenil poni ndose as misma como ejemplo al recordarle a esta su situaci n con Lu s Fernando y como se vio obligada a alejarse de el para darle paso a M Gracia en vista del embarazo de esta. A su encuentro con Aureliano Dileidy obliga al muchacho a definir su situaci n exigi ndole una garant a acerca del termino de su relaci n con Felicita para as poder iniciar ambos una nueva relaci n amorosa. Tatiana se encarga de quebrantar el delicado sentido de autoestima de Felicita al insistir en que su amiga aun permanece gorda todo ello impulsado por la envidia que le produce la relaci n entre Aureliano y Felicita, por otro lado Cristina intenta convencer a Felicita de llamar a Aureliano para as por fin enterrase del motivo de su importante e interrumpida conversaci n. Al decidirse a llamar a Aureliano Felicita sin saberlo crea una controversia entre Dileidy y Aureliano poni ndolo en la disyuntiva de atender su llamada o no. Tatiana siembra la ciza a en Felicita al percatarse de que su llamado no fue atendido, Cristina se vanagloria ante sus amigas al informarlas de lo bien que se desarrolla su supuesta relaci n con Gerson para despu s ser victima de la sorpresa al percatarse de la presencia de Yuraima y su hijo en el puesto de trabajo de Gerson. Tatiana crea un acercamiento entre el hijo de Gerson y Yuraima y Paco sin sospechar que se trata de su propio sobrino. Por medio de la discusi n entre Felicita y Cristina Lu s Fernando se entera de la relaci n que existe entre Aureliano y su antigua novia para tomar la situaci n como una burla de parte de Aureliano en contra de Dileidy. Dileidy se ve colocada en la misma situaci n que Aureliano minutos atr s al recibir el llamado de Lu s Fernando y verse en indecisi n de atenderlo o no. Lu s Fernando sinti ndose alertado por la relaci n que existe entre Felicita y Aureliano insiste en llamar a Dileidy para informarla sobre el asunto que el cree que Dileidy desconoce. Paco conmovido por la presencia de Jugger aprovecha el descuido de M Antonia para llamar a Gladys y as aclarar su situaci n como el padre de Gerson y adem s informarse con certitud si Gerson conoce la verdad de su paternidad. Gladys le plantea a Gavito un resumen de su decisi n de quedarse sola en la vida sin compromisos ni ataduras con ning n hombre.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 102: Boda interrumpida y secretos de familia
programme.desc: En la cl nica Felix advierte a Betania de la sorpresa que esta a punto de recibir tras invitar a este a leer el informe sobre su madre, Betania dej ndose llevar por su temor rechaza dar lectura al informe dejando as en inc gnita su pasado inter s por saber quien es su madre. Emperatriz hace gala de sus momentos de lucidez al informar a Asunta de lo acontecido con sus hijas, Berta percatada de la situaci n le ordena a Gisela mantener a Emperatriz en encerrada para que esta no logre comunicar la gran angustia que la agobia tras haber perdido a sus hijas. En la pensi n el secretario da inicio a la boda civil entre Marisela y Alfredo, Diego Andr s intenta impedir la ceremonia con su interrupci n al enfrentar a Marisela para que esta revele la verdad de sus sentimientos.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, Mar a Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandon a las dos mucho tiempo atr s para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de Mar a Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que tambi n tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relaci n extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. Mar a Antonieta fallece despu s de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: Episodio 26
programme.desc: Trinidad le da su bendición a Irene y todos parten hacia la casa de los Ferrándiz. Leonardo está enojado con Juan Pablo y Carlos por decirle que hay un enemigo que quiere destruirlo. La prensa y fotógrafos rodean la mansión Ferrándiz pero ninguno puede ingresar porque no tienen permiso. Rodrigo encuentra a un cocinero de la fiesta y lo soborna para que saque fotos dentro de la fiesta y así recibiría una gran cantidad de dinero. El cocinero acepta. Jimena encuentra hablando por teléfono a Altaír con Alejandra, a la cual le cuenta lo aburrida que esta la fiesta. Agustina amenaza a Irene con destruirla por meterse en esa familia. Finalmente Irene y Alejandro se casan. En la fiesta Leo y Julio se comienzan a pelar por María Lucía a la cual Leo no le saca la vista de lo radiante que está.

programme.title: Episodio 114: El Amor de Salvador es Socorro
programme.desc: Socorro entra a su casa por el patio y va a atender a Salvador con gafas y cubierta con un chal. Ella le explica que es fan tica suya por influencia de su padre, luego llega la vecina con el beb de Socorro y Salvador se enternece con. Antes de marcharse Salvador recibe una llamada de Josefina para pedirle que le diga a Barbie que no ventile el asunto de Manuel con Charo. Salvador cuelga y le dice a Flor que la nica mujer que ha amado y amar es a Socorro.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 114: Ricardo niega a Gabriel; Isadora escapa
programme.desc: Cuando Marisela le dice a Ricardo que Gabriel es su verdadero padre l no le cree, le dice que ella est mintiendo y que nunca aceptar a Gabriel como su padre. Flavia y Fernando le cuentan a Gabriel que Isadora escap de la cl nica despu s de agredirlos y Gabriel sale a buscarla, junto con Reynaldo. Mientras Isadora le est pagando al taxista, alucina y nuevamente reflejado en el espejo retrovisor, ve al difunto Alfonso. Isabela le dice a Gavil n que Alfonso Malav era su padre y por lo tanto ellos son familia. Daniel huye con sus amigos de la casa hogar, despu s de haberle disparado a su abuelo. Mientras Ricardo habla ofensivamente de Gabriel, diciendo que jam s lo aceptar como padre, Gabrielita defiende a su pap y Marisela sale con el testamento de la habitaci n de la cl nica.

programme.title: Episodio 27
programme.desc: Jimena le dice a Carlos que sabe lo del romance que tuvo con Altaír, aunque éste lo niegue. Al terminar la fiesta, Irene le dice a María Lucía que al día siguiente iría a visitar a su madre. Luego se aparece Alejandra con un regalo, pero tanto Irene como Leonardo, la echaron de la casa. Alejandra enfurecida por la humillación se lo confiesa a Rodrigo quien le dice que pronto todo pasara. María Lucía le comenta a Trinidad que Irene irá de visita pero Trinidad la ignora diciendo que todos los hijos una vez que están casados no cumplen sus promesas. Leonardo quiere tener intimidad con Irene, pero ésta se opone diciendo que todo esto ya lo habían pactado. Leonardo sigue insistiendo y al menos consigue dormir a su lado.

programme.title: Episodio 115: El Beb y el Enga o de Walter
programme.desc: Salvador lee la nota que le dej Socorro con las instrucciones para el beb donde tambi n le dice que regresar cuando termine de hacer unos tr mites. Salvador piensa que esa mujer est loca. Salvador se lleva al beb a su entrenamiento en el club de box y le deja a Socorro una nota cont ndole esto. Cuando Salvador sale de su casa encuentra a Flor escondida, pero huye y no logran hablar. - Walter llega donde Josefina para que desayunen juntos y la convence de que se deje pintar con el pretexto de que ese cuadro podr a hacer que Julio C sar la dejara en paz.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 115: El testamento, la lucha y el c ncer
programme.desc: Isadora lucha con Marisela mientras Jes s quema el testamento y su destrucci n perjudicar a a Marisela y a Ricardo, mientras Jes s dice que l no es el padre de Ricardo, Isadora, grita que queme el documento. Mientras Gabriela lucha contra el c ncer su padre, el doctor Anselmi y Ricardo le brindan apoyo, en esos momentos dif ciles. Abril se entera que Gavil n firm una declaraci n diciendo que es c mplice del asesinato del pap de Gabriela a lo que ella se queja diciendo que hasta cuando la sombra de Malav los va a perseguir. Marisela le dice a Isadora que le tiene que devolver la mitad de la fortuna como lo dice testamento. Marisela se enfrenta a Jes s, Ignacio, e Isadora con respecto a su testamento.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Portugal: Portuguese cuisine holds a dear place in Tony's culinary heart. Tony travels to Porto, home of the famous Port wine, where he is immediately exposed to the codfish and the almost mythical place it holds in Portuguese cuisine and culture.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: What is a Carioca? The natives of Rio de Janiero, Brazil are lovable scamps who find ways to avoid work, preferring the beach, flirting, and hanging out at restaurants and bars instead. Tony, under the tutelage of an exemplary Carioca, gives the lifestyle a try.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: San Sebastian: A Food Lover's Town
programme.desc: San Sebastian, Spain: Tony explores the food-crazed Basque culture. Tony's guide, Chef Luis Irizar, takes Tony into the underworld of Basque gastronomic societies. Later, Tony explores the city's tapas bars.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Morocco (Sahara): Tony traverses the Moroccan desert with one goal in mind, to eat a mud-oven-roasted sheep.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Rural Japan: Tony decides to look for a more relaxing, traditional Japanese culinary experience in the countryside. Tony travels to an old-style Japanese inn that specializes in kaiseki cuisine, ancient tea ceremony, and local ingredients.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Jumping into a Thai tuk tuk taxi, Tony attempts to soak up Thai culture, and get lost in the cuisine of Chiang Mai, Thailand.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: The Mercado Lazaro Cardenas is standard as far as markets in Mexico City go, but turn one corner, and you are in the world of coffee geeks, of which Rick is a proud citizen. Rick also meets with mixologists Joseph Mortera and Ricardo Nava.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: Mole is an idea that is half pre-Columbian, half European, and 100% Mexican. It is a sauce, a preparation, and a national dish that rivals the culinary masterpieces of the world's greatest cuisines. Explore the exquisite mysteries of mole.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: Rick is on a mission to tell the world about tequila, beginning with a party for 25 at home. Rick hopes to open people's minds and palates to the complexities of Mexico's smooth, super-premium, artisanal tequilas made from 100% blue agave.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: Have you ever seen a kid in a candy store? Their excitement pales next to a chef in a market. Take an exhilarating morning trek to the Central de Abastos, among the world's largest markets, with Rick Bayless and Chef Eduardo "Lalo" Garcia.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: The 19th Century was the golden age of the Mexican hacienda. Today, a handful live on as luxury resorts. Join Rick and his wife Deann in "hacienda heaven" at Hacienda San Jose in the Yucatan, as well as for a dinner party at the Bayless's.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: Sure, there are great male chefs in Mexico. But women are the true mothers of this cuisine. From market cafes to hip new white-tablecloth restaurants, the cuisine of Mexico comes from a rich tradition of hearth, home, and women's hands.

programme.title: History Hunters
programme.desc: Dave and Steve Nuwar travel to McCartney's auction house to bid on a pilot's logbook from World War I. The men also find three medals from the iconic battle of Waterloo and have a chance to purchase a pair of Martini Henry MKII rifles.

programme.title: Mythical Roads
programme.sub-title: The Route of the Gods: India
programme.desc: Trek along India's Route of the Gods, a journey that transcends dreams and the imagination. We begin in Leh, and end in Benares in the valley of the Ganges, after crossing the Himalayas at over 16,000 feet. Along the way, we will meet extraordinary people that define this remarkable country.

programme.title: Canada's National Parks
programme.desc: Explore a region famed for its hot springs, backcountry treks, and fantastic array of wildlife, and be treated to elegant dining, and chateaux retreats. Also, enjoy train rides aboard the Rocky Mountaineer, scenic drives along the Continental Divide, and Snocoach rides across treacherous ice fields.

programme.title: Great Destinations
programme.desc: Zakynos is a well-known Greek summer resort. The harbor city of Zakynthos, the capital, is centered around Solomos Square. Stunningly beautiful coves and beaches like Agios Nikolaos, Alykanas, and Tsilivi offer swimming and water sports.

programme.title: Ross Kemp: Deep Sea Treasure Hunter
programme.desc: Plymouth is the port most associated with Britain's imperial ambitions. Using metal detectors, Ross and his team discover what Mallory believes is a new shipwreck, as well as treasure. Their quest also leads them to the Gulf of Suez.

programme.title: Ross Kemp: Shipwreck Treasure Hunter
programme.desc: Continuing his adventure in Scapa Flow, Ross plunges down to the German Warship SMS Karlsruhe where he discovers the cause of its demise. The answer leads him 600 miles away to the wreck of an experimental 1920s submarine aircraft carrier.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager takes us to Peru's Paracas National Reserve that protects both white sand deserts and marine ecosystems, including the Nazca lines. Also, explore the origins of Afro-Peruvian music and trek across the Peruvian Galapagos.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: The city of Iquitos, Peru is a gateway into the wilds of the Northern Amazon jungle. Sail by boat along the Amazon River and experience firsthand the rich diversity of this region and everything that makes it a very special place.

programme.title: Bigger Bolder Baking with Gemma Stafford
programme.desc: Become a baking hero this Holiday Season! Chef Gemma Strafford show you how to craft delectable baked goods that will impress at every celebration.

programme.title: Takeaway Titans
programme.desc: Ireland's top 6 chippers fry their way into the hearts and minds of Chef Dylan McGrath, takeaway expert Suzie Lee, and celebrity judge Deirdre O'Kane, to ultimately compete in the season's final cook off challenge.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge's Proper Pub Food
programme.desc: We all enjoy eating outdoors in a beer garden, and Tom wants to show us how to create outdoor food properly. Chicken in a basket with a twist, a tasty fish burger, a delicious maple cake, extra special barbecued beef ribs… it is chow time.

programme.title: The Healthy Voyager's Global Kitchen
programme.desc: Carolyn Scott-Hamilton, the Healthy Voyager, demonstrates how to prepare Vegan Colombian Arepas.

programme.title: Chuck and the First Peoples' Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Abegweit First Nation, Prince Edward Island
programme.desc: Chuck travels to Scotchfort, an Abegweit First Nation community on Prince Edward Island. Accompanied by Brezlyn and a special guest, he goes eel fishing and meets Junior Peter-Paul, a community Elder who teaches him about oysters.

programme.title: Smart Travels with Rudy Maxa
programme.desc: The Champagne region of France bubbles over with fine wine, gourmet cuisine, picturesque towns, and gothic spires. We base in Reims, home of the historic cathedral where French kings were crowned. From Reims, we tour wine country, visiting champagne producers both large and small.

programme.title: Bare Feet with Mickela Mallozzi
programme.desc: The Asian American and Pacific Islander (AAPI) community is a beautifully diverse group of cultures, and Mickela gets a taste of the Pacific Islands around the boroughs by experiencing Na Pua Mai Ka Lani Nuioka, Soh Daiko, Taiko, and more.

programme.title: Bare Feet with Mickela Mallozzi
programme.desc: Mickela kicks off her New York series in one of the oldest and most iconic neighborhoods in N.Y.C., Manhattan's Chinatown, during the festive time of Chinese Lunar New Year.

programme.title: Family Travel with Colleen Kelly
programme.desc: Colleen's family enjoys a minor league baseball game, catches and prepares their own food, discovers the importance of rescuing and rehabilitating marine life, and checks out the amazing things that can be built with sand.

programme.title: Family Travel with Colleen Kelly
programme.desc: After checking out Porto's Bakery, a local hotspot, the girls make (and attempt to eat) a gargantuan ice cream sundae at Farrell's Ice Cream Parlour. Sugared up, they head over to Big Air Trampoline Park before getting captured by pirates.

programme.title: Running of the Bulls
programme.desc: The Festival of San Fermin in Pamplona, Spain is a deeply rooted celebration of traditional and folkloric events, including the Running of the Bulls. Experience the incredible energy each morning for eight consecutive days as thousands of people run ahead of six, 2,000-pound charging bulls.

programme.title: Lonely Planet: Best Parks Ever - America's National Parks
programme.sub-title: Best Parks for Jaw Dropping Scenery
programme.desc: See Mother Nature at its best. From the highest waterfall to the one of the biggest holes in the world, it's this kind of scenery that will make you stop in your tracks.

programme.title: Lonely Planet: Best Parks Ever - America's National Parks
programme.desc: With acres of sea lions and thousands of buffalo, national parks host the largest homes to all kinds of critters. Get close to your favorite animal in this episode of Best Parks Ever.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Mount Washington, New Hampshire has the dubious title of being home to the world’s worst weather. The highest wind ever recorded on the planet – 231 miles per hour – was recorded at its mountaintop observatory. To prepare for a mid-winter assault on the summit, Angry Planet host George Kourounis becomes a “human popsicle”, encased in ice in at the National Resarch Council’s high speed wind tunnel. Then he and his sidekick Mark Robinson climb to the top of the mountain in mid-January and brave their way into a summit blizzard.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Dominica, the most volcanic and mountainous island in the Caribbean, is home to the Boiling Lake, a large waterfall-fed lake of furiously boiling water. Adventurer George Kourounis becomes the first person ever to traverse across the lake on a rope, risking his life to take water samples and shoot video from a place no human has ever been. He then dives to the ocean floor off the coast of the island to explore vents where the superheated water bubbles into the ocean.

programme.title: Dracula in Love
programme.desc: Leila, a lonely young soul spends the night partying with her friends Nancy, David and Nash in a warehouse. As the boys drink up and smoke pot all social barriers between the sexes crumble. Leila, hit on by both men, hides away from them. Alone she senses there is someone else who wants her and certainly he is not of this world. A 200 year old Dracula escapes from a crate and reveals himself to Leila and tells her that she is his lost love. For him to live again and be with her, she must bring him the blood of her friends to drink and make love to him. Hypnotized by his sexual powers, Leila does as she is told. Leila and a handsome young Dracula get away and live happily ever after.

programme.title: Sennentuntschi
programme.desc: 1975, Swiss Alps: In a remote mountain village, a beautiful and mysterious woman shows up. Only the village policeman takes care of the strange woman and tries to find out who she is. There are hints that she came from the H??henalp Alp, where herdsmen do unthinkable things to get the company of women. Many dark truths are revealed that should better have remained hidden. A tragedy of lust, insanity and murder is brought to a seemlingly pure and perfect world. It is the beginning of a nightmare of religious insanity, hypocrisy, abuse and belief in demons, who destroys a young family and brings a whole village to destruction.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Nos acompaña Clara Corona de Lau, consultora en cultura organizacional, fundadora de Think Lynk y pionera en transformar la forma en que vivimos nuestro espacio laboral. Reconocida por múltiples presidentes de México y galardonada con el Premio Nacional del Empresario, Clara nos comparte su visión sobre liderazgo, bienestar y propósito dentro del entorno laboral. - Descubrimos los pilares que hacen de una empresa un lugar extraordinario: confianza, valores, empatía y una cultura sólida. También exploramos la historia de su reconocida empresa “Biomédica de Referencia”, ejemplo de excelencia y humanidad. - Un episodio inspirador que revela cómo la cultura organizacional no es un lujo, sino el corazón mismo del éxito.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: Conversamos con Jerónimo Best, actor y productor de teatro que ha llevado su carrera a escenarios nacionales e internacionales, incluyendo la Royal Shakespeare Company en Reino Unido. Jerónimo nos comparte sus inicios en el teatro, la emoción de pisar escenarios legendarios y cómo la actuación, en inglés y en español, transforma la manera de sentir y comunicar emociones. Además, Jerónimo reflexiona sobre su labor como productor, traductor y adaptador de proyectos teatrales, así como la importancia de crear equipos actorales que funcionen como una familia. Con humor, sensibilidad y mucha pasión por el oficio, Jerónimo nos invita a mirar el teatro como un espacio donde la ficción detiene el tiempo y nos recuerda el poder de las historias para emocionar, unir y transformar.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Conversamos con Yolnicte Bassave, especialista, CEO y emprendedora en el sector de la medicina estética. En este episodio abordamos cómo la estética puede transformar, pero también cómo debe practicarse con ética, medida y conciencia. Con 17 años de trayectoria, Yolnicte nos habla de la importancia de embellecer dignamente y de reconocer cuándo un cambio estético responde a un deseo auténtico o respuesta a una presión externa. Reflexionamos sobre tendencias, riesgos, comparación social, y el papel de la asesoría profesional para lograr resultados naturales y seguros. Una charla directa y experta que invita a repensar nuestra relación con la belleza y el cuidado personal.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Conversamos con Ana María González, coach fitness apasionada por ayudar a las personas a encontrar constancia y propósito en el movimiento. Desde consejos prácticos para tonificar el cuerpo, mejorar la postura o fortalecer el core, hasta herramientas para establecer objetivos realistas y sostenibles, nos comparte cómo pequeños hábitos pueden transformar nuestra salud física y mental. Ana nos adentra en el mundo del indoor cycling, una disciplina de alta intensidad que ha ganado popularidad por su impacto positivo en la salud y su capacidad de conectar con la música y la motivación colectiva. Además, hablamos sobre nuevas tendencias como el Barré y el Hyrox, la importancia de romper estereotipos de género en el fitness y cómo el ejercicio puede convertirse en una experiencia 360 que va más allá del cuerpo, impulsando comunidad, autoconocimiento y bienestar.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: Conversamos con Sergio Gutiérrez, actor, guionista y director independiente, sobre sus inicios en la actuación, su pasión por los escenarios y el proceso de construir personajes completos. Con una trayectoria que incluye participaciones en series de televisión, streaming y teatro, Sergio comparte anécdotas de sets masivos, entrenamientos con dobles de riesgo y su paso por producciones como míticas. Reflexionamos sobre la importancia de no juzgar a sus propios personajes, la presencia total en escena, y el valor del capital humano en tiempos de inteligencia artificial. Una charla auténtica y dinámica que revela lo que significa vivir la actuación desde todas sus trincheras.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: Conversamos con Manu Calderón, actor, director y guionista. Compartió espisodios importantes sobre su trayectoria, que abarca desde teatro y comedia, hasta cine y series biográficas. Manu comparte sus inicios, las influencias que marcaron su carrera, como Pedro Infante, y anécdotas de casting tan inusuales como interpretar un plátano. Hablamos del compromiso que conllevan los personajes de soporte, de cómo abordar figuras icónicas sin perder la autenticidad y de la importancia de un buen casting en series basadas en hechos reales. También reflexionamos sobre la vulnerabilidad del actor, la capacidad de cambiar entre géneros y lo que no se ve detrás de un set. Una charla cercana y divertida que muestra el oficio actoral desde la pasión y la entrega absoluta.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Conversamos con Fernanda de la Colina, especialista en educación financiera y cofundadora de Zumma, sobre los pilares fundamentales para tener unas finanzas personales sanas, realistas y sostenibles. Con un enfoque accesible y práctico, Fernanda explica conceptos clave como el interés compuesto, el manejo del crédito, las deudas buenas y malas, y la importancia de invertir desde edades tempranas. A través de respuestas rápidas, cápsulas informativas y consejos claros, este episodio busca desmitificar el mundo financiero y empoderar a las personas para tomar mejores decisiones con su dinero. - Este episodio es una guía útil para quienes quieren comenzar a organizar sus finanzas, ahorrar con propósito o entender cómo y por qué invertir, todo desde una mirada fresca, joven y fundamentada.

programme.title: Romance En Valentine
programme.desc: Kennedy Blaine, una joven Californiana, hereda un rancho en el pequeño pueblo de Valentine, en Nebraska. Antes de vender la propiedad, Kennedy decide pasar unas semanas en el rancho y descubrir la historia de su familia. Confiando en la protección de Dios y en la ayuda de Derek Sterling, el administrador del rancho, se lanza a descubrir cuáles fueron los acontecimientos que obligaron a sus padres a dejar todo y mudarse a California.

programme.title: Renovación Del Corazón
programme.desc: Cuando los Dover se encuentran en peligro financiero, tienen que vender la casa que le dejaron los padres de Anne. La única forma de deshacerse de la casa es arreglarla, pero las cosas no salen exactamente como estaba planeado.

programme.title: Alimento para El Corazón
programme.desc: Los planes de la chef Lia de ampliar su servicio sin ánimo de lucro de reparto de comida a domicilio centrado en el corazón fracasan debido a su insistencia en hacerlo todo ella misma. Pero con la ayuda de su nuevo vecino y reciente padre adoptivo Eli descubrirá que los negocios, al igual que el romance, pueden florecer con un poco de esfuerzo y confianza.

programme.title: Amor Civil
programme.desc: Rachel es una viuda durante la Guerra Civil que responsabiliza al Sur por la muerte de su esposo. Cuando un soldado enemigo herido se refugia en su granero, Rachel lo ayuda a regañadientes. A medida que lo conoce más, se da cuenta de que debe protegerlo de los hombres peligrosos que lo persiguen y descubre un coraje que no sabía que tenía: el coraje de volver a amar.

programme.title: Encontrando El Amor En Big Sky
programme.desc: Una chica de campo, Paisley, cuida del rancho de su abuelo. Tras negársele la financiación necesaria para reformar el rancho, pide ayuda a su exnovio Josh, un importante ejecutivo de marketing.

programme.title: Hogar Dulce Hogar
programme.desc: Una camarera ayuda a un hombre a construir una casa para una familia necesitada, mientras espera que él se fije en ella.

programme.title: El Amor a través del Tiempo
programme.desc: Mientras inspecciona una antigua mansión británica por su potencial inmobiliario, Chelsea descubre un portal a través del tiempo que conecta con el dueño de la propiedad de finales de 1700. Cuando se produce un accidente, el caballero atraviesa el portal y queda atrapado en el presente.

programme.desc: Don César de Echagüe, haciéndose pasar por el vengador "El Coyote", continúa la lucha de las tropas americanas contra la injusticia y la perversión de la justicia contra la población hispana de California a mediados de la década de 1840.

programme.title: Bienvenido, padre Murray
programme.desc: El padre Murray llega a Valley City, en la frontera con México; allí debe velar por la observancia de la moral, que últimamente está en decadencia. Sin embargo, como es un hombre negro, esto provoca la irritación de los habitantes del pueblo, que colgaron a un hombre negro por robo y asesinato hace varios años sin demostrar su culpabilidad sin lugar a dudas: el padre del sacerdote. El verdadero criminal, Ray Terris, ahora también hace todo lo posible para obstaculizar al sacerdote en el cumplimiento de su tarea, durante la cual también salen a la luz sus recientes planes de robo. Pero al final, la justicia triunfa.

programme.title: Maniquí
programme.desc: Lo que empieza como un cuento de hadas no siempre tiene un final feliz en la vida. La realidad es tal que a menudo el cuento de hadas de la vida termina con un final dramático. Los hechos tienen lugar en 1978. Una ingenua huérfana criada en un internado de provincias llega a la bulliciosa y concurrida capital. Sasha ya ha cumplido 18 años y necesita empezar una vida adulta e independiente. Una chica consigue un trabajo en la Casa de la Moda como limpiadora. Es aquí donde tiene que pasar de ser un felpudo discreto a un modelo famoso. Con el tiempo llegan a su vida hombres que le prestan todo tipo de atención. Tres hombres comienzan a cortejarla, todos ellos tratando de conquistar el corazón de Sasha: un artista de vanguardia llamado Iván, un vendedor ambulante llamado Vadim, que se ha criado en una familia muy respetable de la capital, y un mayor del KGB llamado Kim. ¡Pero Sasha ya ha elegido al hombre de sus sueños y para estar junto a él tendrá que pasar por un número increíble de pruebas!

programme.title: Maniquí
programme.desc: Sasha e Iván son felices, sin sospechar que han atraído la atención de Kim Olegovich, un mayor de la KGB y supervisor de la Casa de Modelos. Su objetivo es separarlos. Kim, sintiendo una atracción personal por Sasha, utiliza el chantaje y la manipulación para acercarse a ella. La relación entre Sasha e Iván comienza a desmoronarse ante sus ojos. Kim está a punto de lograr su propósito, pero entonces recibe una noticia inesperada: Sasha se va a casar. La noticia sacude no solo a Kim, sino también a toda la Casa de Modelos.

programme.title: Maniquí
programme.desc: La vida de Sasha con un esposo al que no ama se vuelve insoportable. Pero en su camino hacia la felicidad con Iván aún se interpone Kim Olegovich. Atrapados y sin salida, los amantes toman una decisión desesperada…

programme.title: Maniquí
programme.desc: Al llegar a un acuerdo con Kim, Sasha abre el camino para su viaje a París. Iván, por su parte, planea emigrar a Israel con la intención de trasladarse después a Francia. La Casa de Modelos triunfa en sus desfiles en París, pero la estrella de la pasarela, Alexandra Linkova, está visiblemente nerviosa. Kim se da cuenta de que Sasha está planeando algo y no deja de vigilar cada uno de sus movimientos…

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: The Fifth Estate
programme.desc: The top-notch team of hosts Bob McKeown, Gillian Findlay, Mark Kelley and Habiba Nosheen provides unique and engaging documentaries from Canada and beyond. "The Fifth Estate" is a reference to the term Fourth Estate, and was chosen to highlight the program's determination to go beyond everyday news into original journalism. The series has won numerous awards for its reporting, including Gemini Awards, International Emmys, the Michener Award, and even an Academy Award for a 1981 episode that was released in theaters the following year. Since September 1975, Canadians have tuned in to experience interesting stories that are always well-crafted and thought-provoking.

programme.title: El Soldado de la Mafia: Mercenario
programme.desc: Grupos armados están arrasando con todo aquel que intente entrar a su territorio, pero un soldado valiente decide enfrentarlos y apoderarse del imperio.

programme.title: Los Criminales Del R1
programme.desc: Sandro es un joven ambicioso que ni compra, ni hace pactos, simplemente arrebata. Su rival es Luís Pacheco, un hombre astuto y vanidoso. Sandro desea el control total de la plaza, por lo que está punto de arremeter a sangre y fuego.

programme.title: La Revancha

programme.title: La Tiendita.
programme.desc: Genaro es un tipo relajado a quien la palabra trabajo le produce alergia. Las deudas lo acosan y se ve forzado a pedir dinero prestado. Empieza la odisea y aventuras cargadas de ocurrentes situaciones.

programme.title: Cárteles Unidos
programme.desc: El gobierno ha declarado la guerra a todos los cárteles del país. La consigna es acabar con el crimen organizado. Organizaciones criminales que se disputan territorios clave y defienden los propios a sangre y fuego.

programme.title: El Plebe Chakaloso
programme.desc: Una historia de corrupción y de avaricia entre un policía corrupto que trabaja para el mejor postor y un hombre que traiciona a violentos cárteles.

programme.desc: El Diablo, un joven de 24 años, se ha ganado la confianza de un reconocido narcotraficante, gracias a sus sanguinarias victorias y su firme lealtad. Volverá al infierno al cometer un error imperdonable.

programme.desc: El se verá en una encrucijada mortal cuando vaya tras la pista de un sanguinario narcotraficante. Su misión pondrá en riesgo su existencia y la de su familia.

programme.title: Spy Cat
programme.desc: Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy’s entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits- and his best friend Batty’s help!- to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she’s turned into a human girl!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy becomes convinced that there’s a wilderwolf at Howlington, and launches a daring investigation to prove that it’s the school accountant, Mr Sminch. Howlington gets a new teacher, the super cool and charming Ric Rawls.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids are struck down by a flea infestation, and Freddy and Batty are tasked with tracking down the mysterious Doog, keeper of the Fleaminator, the most powerful flea treatment known to dog, before they’re all expelled!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s Howloween, and Howlington is on lockdown. But when the students stage a play that goes wrong and the lockdown is disrupted, it will be up to the kids to save the grown-ups from themselves - including Principal Pincus!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy and Ivan have failed their runes exam and have to do it over - or they won’t be allowed to attend the Doom Wolves concert. But their study session ends up putting themselves, and the Doom Wolves, in grave danger!

programme.title: Back to the Sea
programme.desc: When little fish Kevin is swept up in a net and taken from his home in the vast oceans to the small glass fish tank of a restaurant, he must find a way to escape and make his way back home.

programme.title: Racetime
programme.desc: Frankie and Sophie challenge newcomers Zac and Charlie to an epic sled race.

programme.title: Son of Bigfoot
programme.desc: A teenage boy journeys to find his missing father only to discover that he's actually Bigfoot.

programme.title: Ozzy
programme.desc: The lovable Ozzy’s pampered life is thrown into turmoil after his family drops him at Blue Creek before their vacation. Ozzy quickly learns that Blue Creek is a dog prison and he’ll need to rely on some new friends to help him break out and get back home.

programme.title: Stardog & Turbocat
programme.desc: A loyal dog and a vigilante cat embark on a space age voyage to find their way home.

programme.title: Rally Road Racers
programme.desc: A rookie race-car driver gets the opportunity to compete against the reigning champion. With help from a former driver, he must overcome treacherous terrain, rival racers and unexpected obstacles to prove he has what it takes.

programme.title: Cats
programme.desc: A cat named Blanket lives in the city with his son, Cape. One day, Cape decides to leave home and embarks on an adventure to find the legendary cat's paradise. To find his son, Blanket must overcome his fear and reconcile with his past.

programme.title: Tall Tales
programme.desc: When his beloved Queen bee Marguerite is kidnapped, vagabond cricket Apollo who has been framed for the crime, teams up with the other bugs to save the Queen and the entire kingdom.

programme.title: Luis and the Aliens
programme.desc: A boy at risk of being sent to boarding school by his Dad - and three aliens stranded due to watching too much TV - must help each other out.

programme.title: Boonie Bears : The Big Shrink
programme.desc: After purchasing a mysterious shrink ray machine, Vick accidentally shrinks Briar, Bramble, and himself. The tiny team must put aside their differences and embark on one big journey to restore their size and their friendship.

programme.title: Mission to the Moon
programme.desc: In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. With Louis the Magpie as the brave astronaut, what could possibly go wrong? Quite a bit, actually – on the daring mission, secret passengers are discovered, hidden agendas are revealed, and nothing seems to work out the way it was planned. Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy featuring the beloved characters from the Flaklypa universe.

programme.title: Spy Cat
programme.desc: Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

programme.title: Super Mario Bros. Wonder
programme.desc: Mario and friends are invited to the Flower Kingdom by its ruler, Prince Florian, when Bowser suddenly appears, along with Kamek and Bowser Jr.! Bowser then takes hold of the Wonder Flower, merging himself, his Koopa Clown Car, and Prince Florian's castle to become a flying fortress, wreaking havoc across the land and trapping the Poplins in their homes. Abdallah plays as Mario and friends and sets off on a journey to defeat Bowser and save the Flower Kingdom in Super Mario Bros. Wonder on Nintendo Switch with family-friendly commentary.

programme.title: Sonic Superstars
programme.desc: Adventure through the mystical Northstar Islands and harness all-new Emerald powers to move and attack in dynamic new ways. Watch as Abdallah plays as Sonic and friends in Sonic Superstars on Nintendo Switch with family-friendly commentary.

Abdallah plays as Mario and teams up with a party of unlikely allies, like the monstrous Bowser and a mysterious doll named Geno, in Super Mario RPG on Nintendo Switch with family-friendly commentary.

programme.title: UpRooted With Sarah Sharratt
programme.desc: Host Sarah Sharratt visits the artisanal food producers of French Basque country. She helps herd the pigs and sheep that roam the rolling Pyrenees mountains. programme.title: Jamie's Quick & Easy Food

programme.title: Zumbo's Just Desserts

programme.title: Wall of Bakers

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Today’s brand new Come Dine With Me Professionals heads to Cardiff where Mexican taco restaurant, La Pantera get the competition going with co-owner Sam and head chef Gary dishing up a mixture of mackerel and Welsh lamb in their trademark tacos.

programme.title: UpRooted With Sarah Sharratt
programme.desc: Spring has arrived in France and host Sarah Sharratt is hosting friends for a seasonally-inspired lunch. Sarah loves to indulge her guests with French classics and the Spring menu is sure to please: duck pâté, freshly-picked white asparagus, and a tower of colourful macaroons. Lucky for Sarah, there is a food adventure behind each dish.

programme.title: Stone Roses - Made Of Stone
programme.desc: In 2012, a resurrection no one thought possible took place when legendary band, The Stone Roses reformed after 16 years. programme.title: Looking for Johnny: The Legend of Johnny Thunders
programme.desc: Johnny Thunders was the legendary hard-living rock n roll guitarist who inspired glam-metal, punk and the music scene in general. Looking For Johnny is a 90-minute film that documents Thunders career from his beginnings to his tragic death in 1991. The film examines his career as a member of the New York Dolls, the punk scene with The Heartbreakers in New York City and London and much more.

programme.title: Johnny Thunders - Madrid Memory
